title: Bounded erasure with crypto-shredding
narrative: As a data protection officer, I want deleted data unrecoverable everywhere within 30 days so that erasure requests are honoured.

evals.name: raw decrypted scan after compaction
evals.command: cargo run -p dscore-harness --release -- erasure --simulate-days 30 --scan data,wal,analytics --reader decrypting --assert-absent
